TARGET_SEMANTICS.target_array: formal returned returns array (advantages + values), float32
TARGET_SEMANTICS.values_and_next_values_source: pre-update current Main Macro Critic snapshot for the relevant episode
TARGET_SEMANTICS.independent_target_teacher: each specialist's own initial Critic snapshot (identical initial state)
TARGET_SEMANTICS.sequential_target_teacher: current continuously inherited Critic snapshot immediately before that episode's 50 steps

PART_A_INDEPENDENT_SPECIALISTS.definition: I[i,j] = critic trained only on Ei then evaluated on Ej against realized RTG

OBSERVATION_SUPPORT_DIAGNOSTICS.distance_input: float64 distances over the exact float32 transformed observations (2*x-1)
OBSERVATION_SUPPORT_DIAGNOSTICS.cross_episode_nn_definition: two-sided: concatenate each point's nearest neighbor distance in the other episode; report directional means/medians too
OBSERVATION_SUPPORT_DIAGNOSTICS.within_episode_nn_definition: each point's nearest non-self neighbor distance
OBSERVATION_SUPPORT_DIAGNOSTICS.ratio_definition: two-sided cross-NN mean / mean(within-NN mean_i, within-NN mean_j)

PART_B_SEQUENTIAL_RETENTION.definition: S[t,j] = evaluation on Ej after continuous sequential training through Et

DIAGNOSIS.mapping_contradiction_proven: NO CLAIM; negative transfer can reflect mapping shift, support/OOD extrapolation, or missing latent context

rules_used.catastrophic_forgetting: at least two acquisition episodes Corr>0.1, at least two such episodes with a later Corr drop>0.2, and mean positive-only backward drop>=0.1; >0.2 is descriptive, not sole decision rule
rules_used.cross_realization_generalization_failure: independent off-diagonal Corr median<0.1 and next-unseen Corr mean and median both<0.1
rules_used.state_support_shift: at least three adjacent-pair ratios>=2 and adjacent median ratio>=2; descriptive criterion
rules_used.bidirectional_E1_E2_conflict: both independent cross-direction Corr values < -0.2; transfer incompatibility only

DIAGNOSIS.representation_or_context_shift_basis: Repeated adjacent state-support separation is strongly supported; this flags covariate/support shift suspicion only and does not establish a conditional state-to-return mapping change.
DIAGNOSIS.interpretation: Independent and forward metrics are heterogeneous. The very negative E1-to-E2 transfer is one-directional (reverse independent correlation is near zero), and sequential learning E2 improves E1. All five adjacent support ratios are high. Treat this as support/OOD shift evidence, not proof of mapping contradiction.

RECOMMENDED_A0_8B_DESIGN: 当前结果未满足 catastrophic forgetting 判据；暂不优先执行 Replay。若后续仍需区分 P2，可做最小 Replay-0 vs Replay-last3；Replay-last3 应在每个 Ei 更新前冻结当前 Critic，并用同一个快照对 Ei、Ei-1、Ei-2 重新计算正式 SMDP λ=.7 targets，按 episode 等权平均 loss，避免 stale historical λ-target 与 transition 数量加权混淆。A0.8b 本轮未执行。
